_help: Act 3, stage one: how the expedition goes to Akmentar. Format: scripts/boards/route_board.gd. race_step: lower = closer to Akmentar for the final race.
title: The road to Akmentar
intro: Three ways out of Cairo. The first to arrive claims the best sites.

options.label: Across the desert
options.desc: The fastest way: straight across the sand. You'll need horses, the most expensive start, and a desert guide is worth a great deal out here. The road splits at an old temple.

options.label: The riverboat
options.desc: The cheapest passage for people and equipment. The American expedition has booked the same boat.

options.label: Along the coast
options.desc: The longest way round, but two trucks can carry the expedition and the coast road avoids the worst of the desert.
